reason: Modelled from the Sensirion SGP40 datasheet v1.2. The driver sends sgp40_measure_raw_signal (0x26 0x0F with RH and T words, each with a CRC), waits 30 ms and returns the CRC-checked SRAW_VOC ticks. It also has the self-test (0x28 0x0E) and heater-off (0x36 0x15) commands. The VOC Index algorithm is host-side and is not included. Header order VIN, 3.3V, GND, SCL, SDA comes from Adafruit's pinout photo and page. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-sgp40/pinouts (pinout photo sensors_SGP40_pinouts.jpg: VIN, 3.3V, GND, SCL, SDA left to right)
